head: codex/75-incremental-publication-linkage
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Support non-closing incremental publication linkage
body:
Closes #75

Adds a small strum-backed publication linkage mode with backward-compatible `closing` behavior and exact `part_of` references for incremental parent checkpoints. The mode is retained through intent, remote observation, and canonical publication evidence; mixed or unqualified split-authority linkage fails closed; and `part_of` evidence can never authorize terminal issue closeout.

Focused proof: gate6 11/11, gate_finish 18/18, schema 3/3, publisher binary 7/7, strict Clippy, and exact-head independent review with no findings.
